title: On the existence of a weak martingale solution for a stochastic magnetohydrodynamics system with noise acting in the magnetic field
summary: We prove the existence of solutions to the stochastic magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) system, where randomness is introduced through random initial data and a stochastic integral appearing solely in the induction equation, while the fluid equations remain deterministic. We focus on the case where the adiabatic exponent $γ$ satisfies $γ> \frac{3}{2}$. The existence proof is carried out using the penalization method.
